accessibleLabels.note: counted in source; not verified against a running AT-SPI tree

architecture.accessibilityRoute: AT-SPI via GTK, because the chrome is a client rather than compositor drawing
architecture.compositorDrawnSurfaceAccessibility: none; there is no AT-SPI for pixels

assistiveTechnologyNote: No Orca session was run. Orca needs a session bus, speech-dispatcher and audio, none of which exist in this measurement environment. Every screen-reader statement in the V3 reports is therefore inferred from the toolkit, not observed.

capabilities.note: The chrome is GTK, and GTK exposes AT-SPI. A real Orca session was not run in this environment, so parity is not claimed.
Surfaces drawn by the compositor have no accessible representation. V3 avoids drawing chrome in the compositor for exactly this reason.

capabilities.mechanism: GTK focus handling inside each layer-shell client
capabilities.note: Focus order is GTK's. The compositor guarantees only that the character layer is never focusable and that panels never steal focus.

capabilities.mechanism: compositor focus policy plus GTK focus ring
capabilities.note: The compositor tracks a single focus target and refuses focus changes that no user action caused.

capabilities.mechanism: GTK theme selection in shell clients
capabilities.note: Carried from the V2 token set; not re-measured against a contrast analyser in V3.
Output scaling is implemented and unit tested; a 4K output at 200% resolves to 1920x1080 logical.

capabilities.mechanism: compositor setting honoured by shell clients
capabilities.note: Reduced motion returns a zero animation duration rather than a shortened one.

capabilities.capability: sticky keys, slow keys, mouse keys
capabilities.note: These are seat-level features. The nested winit backend does not expose a libinput seat, so they could not be exercised in this environment.
A compositor can magnify by scaling its output transform. V3 models the setting but does not implement the render path.
The lock surface is a GTK client so it carries AT-SPI, but no assistive technology session was run against a locked screen.

magnification.detail: modelled as a setting; the render path is not implemented in V3

twoHundredPercentScaling.detail: a 3840x2160 output at scale 2.0 resolves to 1920x1080 logical; covered by the compositor's output unit tests
